tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Search canonical companies by name (full-text, best 200 matches), optionally filtered by HQ country. Without q: most active first (large countries continue A–Z after two pages; each answer says its `order` and `max_page`). Returns id, slug

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). One company by slug or uuid: description, tags, parent, subsidiaries, sponsorships, total editions, last seen date.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search event series by name, country or vertical. Each row carries edition count, last and next start dates and the largest captured exhibitor count.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event series by slug or uuid with organizer, venue, tags and every edition (ids, dates, exhibitor / sponsor / speaker / country counts). Use an edition id with list_edition_exhibitors.

tools.name: list_edition_exhibitors
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Exhibitors at one edition (20 per page): exhibitor name, booth, pavilion country, tier and the matched canonical company when known. Free accounts see the first 20 rows plus how many more exist.

tools.name: search_speakers
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). People on the public record as speakers, by name prefix (≥ 2 letters) and/or country. Never returns email or phone.

tools.name: get_speaker
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). One speaker by slug or uuid with bio and the sessions they spoke at (event, edition, year, session title).

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Venues by name prefix and/or country, most event series hosted first, with the number of series each hosts. `q` matches the start of the venue name ("impact", "marina bay", "bitec"), case-insensitive.

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Trade-show and exhibition editions starting in a date window, soonest first, optionally filtered by country, vertical or venue. tools.name: search_organizers
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Event organizers by name and/or country with the number of event series they run.

tools.name: get_organizer
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). One organizer by slug or uuid with description, parent company and its top event series.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). One venue by slug or uuid with city, website, the event series it hosts and its upcoming editions (next 20).

tools.name: list_leaderboards
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Without `kind`: the leaderboard kinds available. With `kind`: the ranked rows (rank, name, value, slug) for that board.

tools.name: country_totals
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Without `country`: the top 20 countries by events. With `country`: events, editions, organizers, venues, companies and speakers counted for that country.

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Search companies and events by meaning rather than keywords ("flame-retardant composites suppliers", "cannabis trade shows in Asia"). Returns the closest matches with a similarity score. Use search_* for exact names.

Halls and rooms in a country that meet a size: optional city, minimum area (m²), minimum clear height (m) and a minimum capacity of one kind (theatre, classroom, banquet, cocktail, booths_3x3). tools.description: Requires a Pro plan. Sponsors of one edition (20 per page, up to 200, highest tier first): company, public tier label, HQ country and url, with the edition's `as_of` (sponsor lists refresh at the full publish). Takes an edition id from get_event.

tools.name: exhibitor_history

Filter by role and year range; pass `cursor` from the previous answer for the next page. `history_truncated` is set for ver

Prospect lists: companies at any `include` edition and at none of the `exclude` editions ("at A or B, not at C"), most editions attended first, then most recent (20 per page). Sources: `edition_exhibitors` (an edition's exhibitors, 1,000 rows per part; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next part), `edition_sponsors` (up to 200), `

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Adds an event, edition, company, organizer, country (ISO code) or vertical (slug) to your workspace's "AI watches" list. Changes (new editions, new exhibitors or sponsors, speakers announced, score changes) arrive in the weekly email diges

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Your workspace's "AI watches": what is watched (type, id, name), how many of your plan's watches are used, the next digest date and the alert channels (email digest; webhooks on the Team plan and up).

tools.name: unwatch
tools.description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). Removes one item from your workspace's "AI watches" (entity_type and id as list_watches shows them). Removing something not watched changes nothing. Needs the 'atlas.reveal' permission.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "check_floorplan" is 1294 chars, far longer than this server's median (258). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_speakers, find_subsidies, list_edition_sponsors, export_list, watch, list_watches · Private data: search_speakers, export_list · Public sink: search_speakers, search_venue_spaces, check_floorplan, list_edition_sponsors, export_list, watch, list_watches · Destructive: search_organizers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_speakers, find_subsidies, list_edition_sponsors, export_list, watch, list_watches · Private data: search_speakers, export_list · Public sink: search_speakers, search_venue_spaces, check_floorplan, list_edition_sponsors, export_list, watch, list_watches · Destructive: search_organizers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
